install.note: DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) is DeepSeek's open-source agent harness, currently in developer preview (breaking changes expected). It runs a local web server (`dsh web`) served at http://127.0.0.1:3080 and you open that URL in a browser. Its source requires Node.js ^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0 (22.19.0+ within 22.x, or 24+; Node 23 is excluded). EchoBird configures models by writing ~/.dsh/settings.yaml (an `echobird` provider route under `llm-pi-ai.providers` plus an `agent-default-model` selector) and ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml (the `ECHOBIRD_API_KEY` credential) — both YAML. `dsh` hot-reloads settings.yaml, but EchoBird still restarts the tracked instance on model switch so the change is deterministic.

install_flow.summary: Install the `dsh` binary onto PATH via npm (global or npx), then launch with `dsh web` to start the local backend, and open http://127.0.0.1:3080 in a browser.
agent_steps: Check `node --version` against the official engine range ^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0: accept 22.x from 22.19.0, or 24.0.0 and later; do not accept Node 23. Upgrade an incompatible Node before continuing.
Preferred path (all platforms): if npm is available, run `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`. This puts `dsh` on PATH. Verify with `dsh --version`.
Fallback: run via `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` (downloads on demand, no global install). This is fine for one-off launches but re-resolves each run.

After install, launch with `dsh web` in a terminal. A local launch opens the browser automatically; `--no-open` suppresses it. An SSH launch prints the URL for the SSH client or editor to forward. The default URL is http://127.0.0.1:3080.

Model config lives in `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` (provider routes under `llm-pi-ai.providers` + `agent-default-model`) and `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` (API keys). When the user picks a model in EchoBird, EchoBird writes an `echobird` provider route (displayName EchoBird, `apiKeyEnv: ECHOBIRD_API_KEY`, `api: anthropic-messages` or `openai-completions`, `baseURL` + `models`) and sets `agent-default-model` to `echobird/<model>`, and stores the key under `ECHOBIRD_API_KEY` in `.credentials.yaml`. The chosen model becomes the default for new sessions.
tell_user: Which install method was used (npm global vs npx) and the Node.js version requirement (>= 22.19)
That `dsh` is now on PATH (a NEW terminal may be needed to pick it up)
How to launch: `dsh web` (headless server at http://127.0.0.1:3080 — open that URL in a browser)
To switch models: pick one in EchoBird (it writes settings.yaml + .credentials.yaml), or configure providers directly in the DeepSeek Harness Settings → Models page
